newsitem.title: USA: Belding Heminway names new president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Belding Heminway names new president, CEO.

text.p: Belding Heminway Co Inc said Tuesday it has named its chairman, Karen Brenner, president and chief executive of the thread and crafts company.
Brenner, who has been chairman since May, succeeds Gregory Cheskin, who has resigned to "pursue other interests," the company said.
Cheskin also resigned from the board.
Brenner also serves as a managing director of Noel Group Inc, the majority stockholder of Belding Heminway; chairman and chief executive of Lincoln Snacks Co ; and a director of On Assignment Inc.
